meaning:
φρουρέω, -ῶ
(φρουρός, a guard), [in LXX: I Est.4:56, Jdth.3:6, Wis.17:16, 1Ma.11:3 * ;]
to guard, keep under guard, protect or keep by guarding: 2Co.11:32; metaphorically, Gal.3:23, Php.4:7, 1Pe.1:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.
But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
